Article 5 has applied since 2 February 2025, so point (f) is already in effect.
If the tool is also used to detect cheating, Annex III, point 3(d) covers AI systems for monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour of students during tests. Article 6(2) would make it high-risk, subject to Article 6(3). Article 6(3), last subparagraph, excludes profiling of natural persons from that exception.
The text does not say whether detecting cheating from emotions is a permissible “safety” purpose, nor how a voice-based analysis would be classified.
